thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — elevated 502s and gRPC resets from az1a egress to external NAT. Possible MTU mismatch. Incident ID INC-4123. Link: https://redwood/incidents/INC-4123
infra-oncall: Ack — looking. Kicking off health checks and a tcpdump on an affected host.
infra-oncall: Command: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/egress-az1a.pcap 'tcp and port 443'`
netops-lee: I pulled a sample pcap from the host. Lots of fragmented packets + PSH/ACK retransmits. Vendor NAT inserted MTU=1400 on their path.
infra-oncall: On our infra hosts eth0 shows mtu 9001 (jumbo) — mismatch confirmed.
runtime-sre-maya: Seeing gRPC stream resets correlated with the packet fragmentation window. KV cache churn is spiking, inference tail latencies climb.
infra-oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Route a subset of inference traffic to eu1a fallback pool, 2) Align MTU on a canary host to 1400 and observe.
runtime-sre-maya: Starting traffic steering for inference-v2 route prefix to eu1a (canary 10% -> 50%).
infra-oncall: Routing change applied: `POST /routing/dispatch {"prefix":"inference-v2","target":"eu1a","weight":10}` -> 200 OK
customer-success-rob: CS update: two enterprise customers reported intermittent 502s and ~200-400ms latency spikes for ~12 minutes. No data corruption, but user-facing errors observed.
netops-lee: Quick test on canary host: set MTU 1400 -> `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` then restart networking. After that, gRPC resets dropped substantially in the capture.
infra-oncall: Applied MTU 1400 to one additional host as staged rollout. Monitoring logs and error rates.
pm-adele: Note for runbook and comms: collect timeline, cause (external NAT MTU mismatch), short-term mitigation (MTU alignment + routing fallback), and next steps for permanent fix with cloud provider/vendor.
runtime-sre-maya: Handoff to night oncall @dana — current state: routing fallback 50% still in place, MTU rollout at 3/12 hosts, error rate down ~70% from peak but still above baseline.
dana: Acked. I'll monitor dashboards (errors, tail latency, kvcache miss) and continue MTU rollout if stable. Will escalate to networking eng if >5% error persists for 10m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4123 status updated: mitigated=partial, active_mitigations=["mtu-canary","route-fallback"], timeline: https://redwood/incidents/INC-4123/timeline
customer-success-rob: I'll draft an initial customer notification: summary of impact, steps we've taken, and ETA for full resolution.
netops-lee: Follow-up action: coordinate with cloud vendor to understand why NAT returned MTU 1400; plan permanent config change or announce recommended MTU in infra docs.
infra-oncall: Leaving notes in postmortem doc and adding runbook step: when external path MTU != host MTU, prefer routing fallback then staged MTU alignment.
pm-adele: Thanks — we'll schedule RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident thread archived to INC-4123 once final update posted.
